integrity: Complete analytical proof supplied. Finite independent full-Lindbladian diagonalizations and resolvent checks are corroborating rather than exhaustive; no unproved all-size claim is based on numerical extrapolation.
limitations: Finite stars K_{1,n} with n>=3, adjacency hopping g nonzero and positive uniform vertex-projector dephasing only; no independent publication-priority review or external validation.
title: Exact Lindbladian spectrum and noise-optimal relaxation on quantum star networks
